batchNotes.primary: Initial test-fixture rows and the final Git importer family are superseded by later complete file runs.
batchNotes.focused: Route and adapter passed. Interim publication rows still refused timeout-wrapped confirmation and are superseded.
batchNotes.gitReconciliation: All sixteen Git importers rerun after the final read allowlist change, plus the missed account caller. Only the two newly discovered files needed additional baseline runs; compare the combined effective table.
batchNotes.finalSeam: Authority changes during the awaited identity read after load-buffer, immediately before paste; complete route and adapter files pass.

newRegressions.publicationEvidence: Actual success and rejecting bare-remote hook both pass: signal remains active, receipt settles, later publication is fenced.

mutation.change: Remove only the authority check after the awaited pane identity read in sendText guard.

sourceChecks.warnings: Existing declarations in registry.ts, taskSync.test.ts and engine.ts, unchanged in this follow-up.

notes: Four initial 50 ms timer assertions are branch-only in the primary sample. Serial whole-file failures vary on both cuts. Nonshared account selection remains 3/3 head versus 0/3 base in these controls; the earlier recorded campaign passed all 23 cases on both cuts.

The head-only stale dirty checkout failure executes a Git wrapper already deleted by delayed cleanup of preceding 30-second lane-close tests. Both lane-close timeouts and their between-test errors occur on main. The initial head run passed the following checkout case.

scripts/local-gate.test.ts reports 59 passes, ten named failures and one between-test error on each cut. The project parser refuses the unidentified between-test diagnostic; neither report counts as passing evidence.
Earlier broad evidence remains in authority-fixes.json and dispatch-preparation.json. No performance gain is claimed.
